recentItems.title: The Heat: Canada-US Tensions | Trade rift widens
recentItems.description:
Tensions between Canada and the US have intensified as tough Canadian tariffs are now hitting the United States. The retaliatory measures went into effect after Canada responded to increased tariffs imposed on it by the Trump administration. How much economic impact will the new tariffs have on both nations?

The host: Anand Naidoo
Guests:
Anthony Chan is a former Chief Economist at JPMorgan Chase & Company.
Aurel Braun is Professor of International Relations and Political Science at the University of Toronto.
Saeed Khan is Associate Professor of Near East & Asian Studies and Global Studies at Wayne State University.
Yves Engler is an author and activist.

recentItems.title: The Heat: US-Iran Conflict | Renewed attacks
recentItems.description:
As the unprovoked US- Israeli conflict against Iran enters its seventh month, the US Energy Secretary Chris Wright said that a nuclear deal may not be reached and that the US has to destroy the nuclear capabilities of Iran. 

Meanwhile over the weekend, three Iranian oil tankers were hit by American forces. According to US Central Command, two were disabled and one sank. Iran vowed to escalate its response to American attacks. #Iran #War #Trump #StraitofHormuz #MiddleEast 

The #Heat Host: Anand Naidoo

Guests: 
Aaron Mate is the host of Pushback with Aaron Mate on the Grayzone.
Saeed Khan is an Associate Professor of Near East & Asian Studies and Global Studies at Wayne State University.
Mohammad Marandi is a Professor of Literature and Orientalism at the University of Tehran and a former advisor to Iran's Nuclear Negotiation Team.
